# Every operation

<!-- generated by scripts/openapi_pages.py from docs/openapi.json: don't edit by hand -->

The 57 operations of Hidesay Bot API 2.0.0, as the server's OpenAPI document describes them. All paths are under `{apiUrl}/bot/v1`. Every call needs the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and every answer is the envelope `{"ok": true, "result": ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": {...}}`.

The SDK column links to the method that runs the operation. It has the same name on `AsyncClient` and `Client`, and on `Bot` and `SyncBot` too, which seal and open what an encrypted chat needs; three are the bot's own business there: polling (`Bot.run`), publishing the key (`Bot.publish_key`) and the Web-Bot key (`Bot.validate_web_bot_data`).

## `GET /me`

**Who the bot is**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getMe` |
| Tag | Me |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_me` |

The bot's own card as the server holds it, plus the limits this server enforces. This works while the bot is paused, so a programme can find out why nothing else does.

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The bot. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `GET /updates`

**Fetch updates (long polling)**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getUpdates` |
| Tag | Updates |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_updates` |

Returns the updates waiting for the bot, oldest first, up to `limit`. With `timeout` the call hangs until something arrives or the clock runs out, and answers an empty list on the clock.

`offset` confirms: every update with an `updateId` below it is deleted and never shown again. Send the highest `updateId` you handled plus one. Without `offset` you get everything still in the queue, which is what a bot asks on its very first call.

Only one poll per bot at a time. A second call ends the first one at once with an empty answer, so two copies of the same programme polling one bot will starve each other: run one.

Not available while a webhook is set: delete the webhook first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | query | integer | no | min `0` | Confirm everything below this id. Highest handled `updateId` + 1. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | min `1`; max `100` | At most this many, 1 to 100. Default 100. |
| `timeout` | query | integer | no | min `0`; max `50` | Seconds to wait for something to arrive, 0 to 50. Default 0. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Updates, oldest first. Empty when nothing arrived before the timeout. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `409` | A webhook is set. Delete it before polling. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /webhook`

**Set a webhook**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `setWebhook` |
| Tag | Updates |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.set_webhook` |

From now on every update is POSTed as JSON to `url`, one update per request, in order, with the header `User-Agent: Hidesay-Bot-Api/1`. If you give a `secret`, every delivery carries it in the header `X-Hidesay-Bot-Api-Secret-Token`: check it and refuse anything without it.

Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds and the update is considered delivered. Anything else, a timeout or a redirect counts as a failure: the server backs off (one second, then doubling, up to an hour) and tries that same update again, so delivery is at least once and never out of order. After ten failures in a row the owner is told in the app. Updates still queue while the webhook is failing and are kept for 72 hours.

The URL must be `https`, carry no credentials or fragment, and resolve to a public address. Setting a webhook ends any poll in progress; `GET /updates` refuses while one is set.

Deliveries arrive from addresses that change over time, so don't allow or block them by IP: check the secret token instead.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | max length `1024` | Absolute https URL. |
| `secret` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$` | Sent back on every delivery in `X-Hidesay-Bot-Api-Secret-Token`. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Set. |
| `400` | The URL is not acceptable (`bad_webhook`) or the body is wrong (`bad_request`). |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |
| `503` | The server couldn't look the host up just now (`try_again`). Nothing is wrong with the URL: send the same request again in a minute. |

## `PUT /key`

**Publish the bot's OpenPGP public key**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `setKey` |
| Tag | Key |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.set_key` |

Turns the bot *protected*: from now on its private chats are end-to-end encrypted, people's phones seal every message to this key, and the bot must send `armored` into those chats. Calling it again with a new key is a rotation; every phone learns the new fingerprint at once.

There is no way to remove the key from the API on purpose: downgrading a bot from protected to open is a decision for its owner, in the console.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `publicKey` | string | yes | max length `65536` | ASCII-armoured OpenPGP public key block. |
| `fingerprint` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{40}$\|^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$` | The key's fingerprint, 40 (v4) or 64 (v6) hex characters. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Published. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `PUT /commands`

**Replace the commands of one scope**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `setCommands` |
| Tag | Commands |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.set_commands` |

The whole list of that scope, replaced. Up to 100 commands; a command is 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and underscores (a leading slash is dropped), its description 1 to 256 characters. Duplicates are folded to the first.

Scopes resolve the way Telegram's do, narrowest first: in a private chat `private` then `default`; in a group `chat:G48213907` (its own id), then `groupAdmins` for administrators, then `groups`, then `default`. An empty scope does not hide a wider one. The owner can edit the same lists in the console; whichever wrote last wins.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | no | pattern `^(default\|private\|groups\|groupAdmins\|chat:[GC]\d{8})$` | `default`, `private`, `groups`, `groupAdmins`, or `chat:<id>` for one group or channel the bot is in (`chat:G48213907`). Missing means `default`. |
| `commands` | array of object | yes |  |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Saved. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `404` | A `chat:G…` or `chat:C…` scope names a chat the bot is not in. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /messages`

**Send a message**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `sendMessage` |
| Tag | Messages |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.send_message` |

Into a chat the bot is in. Send `text` into a readable chat and `armored` into an encrypted one; the wrong kind is refused with `wrong_body_kind` and `expected` says which. Into a readable chat you can also send files (`media`, uploaded first with `POST /attachments`, `text` being the caption) or a `sticker`; into an encrypted one the files go up sealed and the envelope that points at them goes inside `armored`. In a group `media` needs the members' permission to send files, a voice note (`audio`) the one to send voice notes. `mentions` tags people the way the app does. A `markup` adds rows of buttons under the message. `replyTo` quotes a message of the same chat (a wrong id is silently dropped). `silent` only matters in a channel: the post goes out without a notification.

`sendId` makes the call safe to repeat: a UUID of your choosing, and a second call with the same one hands back the message already written instead of writing it twice. Use it whenever you retry after a timeout.

In an encrypted chat, seal the message to every key `GET /chats/{id}/keys` returns and to the bot's own key, sign it with the bot's key, and send the armoured result.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string or integer | yes |  | A chat id as a string, letter included. The private chat with a person also takes their id as a bare number. |
| `text` | string | no | min length `1`; max length `4096` | Readable chats. No control characters apart from newline and tab. |
| `armored` | string | no | max length `131072` | Encrypted chats. An ASCII-armoured OpenPGP message. |
| `replyTo` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `markup` | object or null | no |  | Null is the same as leaving it out. |
| `silent` | boolean | no |  | Channels only: no notification. |
| `sendId` | string | no | format `uuid` | Your id for this send, so a retry writes nothing twice. |
| `media` | array of object | no |  | Readable chats: files uploaded with `POST /attachments`, `text` as the caption. One file, or an album of 2 to 10 pictures and videos. |
| `sticker` | object | no |  | Readable chats: a sticker, see `GET /stickers/{id}`. No text with it. From a public pack, or one the bot was shown, with its `mediaId` as proof. In a group it counts as media: the members need the right to send media. |
| `mentions` | array of string or integer | no |  | Groups: who the words tag (`@[Name](u48213907)`), so they are told even with the group muted, as for a person's tag. Somebody not in the group is dropped. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Sent. A repeated `sendId` answers 200 with the message already written instead of writing it twice. |
| `400` | `bad_request`, `wrong_body_kind` (with `expected`), `bad_markup`, or `bad_media` (a file the bot didn't upload, or described wrong). |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`, `user_gone` (the person closed their account), `blocked_by_user`, or `forbidden` (no right to write here). |
| `404` | `chat_not_found`, or `sticker_not_found` for a sticker the bot may not send. |
| `409` | `conflict`: this `sendId` was already used in another chat. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (sending too fast), `slow_mode` (the group's slow mode) or `rate_limited`. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `PATCH /messages/{messageId}`

**Edit one of the bot's messages**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `editMessage` |
| Tag | Messages |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.edit_message` |

New words, new buttons, or both. The bot's own ordinary messages, at any age: a scoreboard that changes for a week is the normal use. In a channel, with the right to edit posts, anybody's post too (words only: buttons are only ever the sender's). On a file or an album in a readable chat, `text` is the new caption and the files stay; on a sticker, a forward or a message with a link card, `text` replaces the whole body. Service notices the bot caused ("left the group") are not its to edit. In a group or channel the bot must still be allowed to write there: one that was muted, or lost the right to post, can't rewrite what it wrote either (`forbidden`). Leave `markup` out to keep the buttons, send `markup: null` to remove them. People in the chat see the edit live. Edits are counted against the same numbers as sends, in a window of their own: one a second in a private chat, twenty a minute in a group, and the thirty a second overall is shared.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `messageId` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string or integer | yes |  | A chat id as a string, letter included. The private chat with a person also takes their id as a bare number. |
| `text` | string | no | max length `4096` |  |
| `armored` | string | no | max length `131072` |  |
| `markup` | object or null | no |  | Omit to keep the buttons, `null` to remove them. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Edited. |
| `400` | `bad_request` (nothing to change, or a field is wrong), `wrong_body_kind` (`text` into an encrypted chat or `armored` into a readable one, see `expected`) or `bad_markup`. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden`: not the bot's message, or not an ordinary one. In a private chat `blocked_by_user` or `user_gone`. `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found` or `message_not_found`. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `DELETE /messages/{messageId}`

**Delete a message**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `deleteMessage` |
| Tag | Messages |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.delete_message` |

Any message of a private chat, as either person can there; in a group or channel the bot's own, anybody's where it holds the *delete messages* right, and anybody's comment with the *manage comments* right. A post takes its comments with it. Only messages the bot was handed: anything else answers `message_not_found`. Secret messages and service notices cannot be deleted by a bot. `chatId` goes in the JSON body or in the query.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `messageId` | path | integer | yes |  |  |
| `chatId` | query | string or integer | no |  | The chat, when not sent in the body. |

Request body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string or integer | no |  | A chat id as a string, letter included. The private chat with a person also takes their id as a bare number. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Deleted for everyone, for good. `deleted` is always true here: a message that is already gone answers 404 `message_not_found`, so a retry after a timeout can treat that 404 as done. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden` or `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found` or `message_not_found`. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /callbacks/{callbackId}/answer`

**Answer a button press**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `answerCallback` |
| Tag | Buttons |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.answer_callback` |

When somebody presses a button with `callbackData`, the bot gets a `callback_query` update and the button spins on their phone. Answer within 60 seconds: with `text` a short line flashes over the chat; with `alert: true` the text is shown in a box they have to dismiss; with `url` their phone shows the address and offers to open it. An empty answer just stops the spinner. The message itself changes only if you edit it (`PATCH /messages/{id}`).

Each press is answered once. The same person pressing the same button again while their press is open makes no new one; another button, or another person, does.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `callbackId` | path | string | yes |  |  |

Request body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | no | max length `200` |  |
| `alert` | boolean | no | default `false` |  |
| `url` | string | no | max length `1024` | Absolute http(s) URL without credentials. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Delivered to the phone that pressed. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `404` | `callback_not_found`: no such press for this bot. An hour after `expiresAt` a press is forgotten, so a very late answer gets this rather than `410`. |
| `409` | `callback_answered`: already answered. |
| `410` | `callback_expired`: more than 60 seconds have passed. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `PATCH /chats/{chatId}`

**Change a group's or channel's settings**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `updateChat` |
| Tag | Rooms |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.update_chat` |

Each field under the right the app asks for it: `title` and `description` for whoever may change the chat's info (an admin with *change info*, or a member the group lets); `permissions`, `slowModeSeconds`, `membersHidden`, `protectContent`, the reactions and a channel's signatures for an admin with *change info*; `autoDeleteSeconds` for one with *delete messages*; `adminsHidden` for one who may appoint admins. What only the owner decides (history, the public link, the feed) is not here: a bot is never the owner. `permissions` is laid over what members may do now: a name set to false is taken away, true is given, the rest stays. Answers the chat. An empty body is refused (`bad_request`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[GC]?\d{8}$` | A chat the bot is in: `G…` a group, `C…` a channel, a person's id for the private chat with them. Any other id answers `chat_not_found`. |

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | min length `1`; max length `64` |  |
| `description` | string or null | no | max length `500` |  |
| `permissions` | object | no |  | Groups only. |
| `slowModeSeconds` | integer | no | min `0`; max `3600` | Groups only. |
| `membersHidden` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `protectContent` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `reactionsEnabled` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `allowedReactions` | array or null | no |  | Null or empty: any emoji. Each one at most 16 characters, as in the app. |
| `autoDeleteSeconds` | integer | no | min `0`; max `2678400` |  |
| `signatures` | boolean | no |  | Channels only. |
| `signatureProfiles` | boolean | no |  | Channels only. |
| `adminsHidden` | boolean | no |  | Channels only. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Done. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden` or `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found`: no such chat, or the bot is not in it. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `GET /chats/{chatId}/keys`

**The keys to seal a message to**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getChatKeys` |
| Tag | Chats |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_chat_keys` |

For an encrypted chat: the public keys of everybody in it, ids and keys only, no names. Seal your message to all of them and to the bot's own key. Other bots the room hasn't let read every message are left out, as they are for the app: a message meant for one of them is sealed to it on its own. A readable chat has no keys to give and answers `chat_is_open`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[GC]?\d{8}$` | A chat the bot is in: `G…` a group, `C…` a channel, a person's id for the private chat with them. Any other id answers `chat_not_found`. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Keys. |
| `400` | `chat_is_open`: send text, no keys are needed. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found`, or `no_user_key` in a private chat whose person has no key. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `GET /chats/{chatId}/members`

**The roster of a group or channel**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getChatMembers` |
| Tag | Chats |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_chat_members` |

Who is in it and with which seat, as a member in the bot's seat would see it: where the roster is hidden a bot that is not an admin sees the admins only, and a channel that keeps its admins to itself leaves them out. Names and handles only, never phone numbers. `memberCount` counts the list as returned.

## `PATCH /chats/{chatId}/members/{userId}`

**Promote, demote, limit, give a title**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `updateMember` |
| Tag | Rooms |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.update_member` |

The app's rules to the letter. `role` and `adminRights` need the *manage admins* right; `role: "admin"` without `adminRights` gives the room's usual badge, and a right the bot doesn't hold itself is left out without an error. An admin is touched only by the owner or by whoever appointed them. `restrictions` (the rights taken away from this one member, empty to give them back, until `restrictedUntil` or for good) need *ban users* and mean nothing on an admin. `customTitle` and `anonymous` need *manage admins*. The owner is nobody's to change. A bot doesn't change its own role, rights or restrictions; its own title and `anonymous` it may. An empty body is refused. Whether a bot reads the whole room is not here and never will be: the people of the room decide that in the app.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[GC]?\d{8}$` | A chat the bot is in: `G…` a group, `C…` a channel, a person's id for the private chat with them. Any other id answers `chat_not_found`. |
| `userId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^B?\d{8}$` | A person's or a bot's id. A person's also works as the bare digits. |

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | string | no | one of `admin`, `member` |  |
| `adminRights` | array of string | no |  |  |
| `restrictions` | array of string | no |  |  |
| `restrictedUntil` | integer or null | no |  | Unix milliseconds. |
| `customTitle` | string or null | no | max length `64` | Kept and shown cut to 16 characters, as in the app. Empty or null takes it off. |
| `anonymous` | boolean | no |  |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Done. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden` or `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found` or `member_not_found`. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /chats/{chatId}/typing`

**Show "typing" for a few seconds**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `sendTyping` |
| Tag | Chats |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.send_typing` |

The same indicator a person's phone sends. It clears on its own after a few seconds or when a message lands. Only where the bot may write: a restricted bot, or a channel subscriber, gets `403 forbidden`. One goes out per chat every 3 seconds at most, and that counts `typing: false` too: within 3 seconds of the last one the call answers `sent: false` and shows nothing. A person who blocked the bot sees nothing either, and the answer doesn't say so.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `typing` | boolean | no | default `true` |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | `sent` is false when one went out to this chat less than 3 seconds ago. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |

## `POST /messages/forward`

**Forward a message**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `forwardMessage` |
| Tag | Messages |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.forward_message` |

A message the bot was handed, sent on into another chat the bot is in, with "forwarded from" over it (the person, or the channel and its post; a person who switched off the link to their profile keeps their name and loses the link). A forward of a forward keeps the first origin. `hideSender` sends a plain copy instead. Files go along: the server copies them for the bot, so the forward outlives the original.

Readable to readable only. A message from, or into, an end-to-end encrypted chat is forwarded on the bot's side: open it, seal it again to the new chat's keys, send it (`chat_is_protected`). A chat that protects its content does not let its messages out.

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | string or integer | yes |  | A chat id as a string, letter included. The private chat with a person also takes their id as a bare number. |
| `fromChatId` | string or integer | yes |  | A chat id as a string, letter included. The private chat with a person also takes their id as a bare number. |
| `messageId` | integer | yes |  |  |
| `hideSender` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `silent` | boolean | no |  | Channels only: no notification. |
| `sendId` | string | no | format `uuid` |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Forwarded. |
| `400` | `bad_request` or `chat_is_protected`. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden` (no right to write there, or the source chat protects its content), `user_gone`, `blocked_by_user`, `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found` or `message_not_found`. |
| `409` | `conflict`: this `sendId` was already used in another chat. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (sending too fast), `slow_mode` (the group's slow mode) or `rate_limited`. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /attachments`

**Upload a file**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `uploadFile` |
| Tag | Files |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.upload_file` |

A file for a message, as `multipart/form-data` in a field called `file`, at most `limits.uploadBytesMax` bytes (30 MiB unless the server says otherwise in `GET /me`), 30 a minute together with chat pictures. Into a readable chat it goes up as it is (the server seals it at rest) and its `id` goes in the `media` of `POST /messages`. Into an encrypted chat upload it already sealed to the chat's keys and the bot's own, and put the id in the envelope inside the `armored` body: the server never sees inside either.

Request body (multipart/form-data, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes | format `binary` |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Stored. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `413` | `too_large`. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |
| `503` | `try_again`: the server is short of disk right now. |

| `200` | Done. `pinnedMessageIds` is the pins the bot could open, as on `GET /chats/{id}`. |

| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden`, `bot_paused`, or in a private chat `user_gone` or `blocked_by_user`. |

| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /chats/{chatId}/posts/{postId}/comments`

**Comment under a post**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `sendComment` |
| Tag | Messages |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.send_comment` |

The rules a person's comment has: the channel's comments are on and this post's are not closed (`comments_closed`), a member whose voice was taken away stays quiet, `replyTo` points at a comment of the same thread or is dropped. `text` in a readable channel, `armored` in an encrypted one, sealed to the channel's keys. A bot that runs the channel speaks as the channel, unless the channel lets its people sign and `asAuthor` is true. `mentions` are the ids the words tag, so they are told even with the comments muted.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[GC]?\d{8}$` | A chat the bot is in: `G…` a group, `C…` a channel, a person's id for the private chat with them. Any other id answers `chat_not_found`. |
| `postId` | path | integer | yes |  | A post of the channel, one the bot was handed. |

Request body (JSON, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | no | max length `4096` |  |
| `armored` | string | no | max length `131072` |  |
| `replyTo` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `asAuthor` | boolean | no |  |  |
| `mentions` | array of string | no |  |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Sent. |
| `400` | `bad_request` or `wrong_body_kind`. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `comments_closed`, `forbidden`, `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found` or `message_not_found`. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `PUT /chats/{chatId}/photo`

**Change the chat's picture**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `setChatPhoto` |
| Tag | Rooms |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.set_chat_photo` |

png, jpeg, webp or a short mp4/webm clip, judged by its bytes, as `multipart/form-data` in a field called `file`. Whoever may change the chat's info: an admin with the *change info* right, or a member the group lets do it. The picture it replaces stays in the chat's album. A picture up to 5 MiB, a clip up to 12 MiB. Uploads count here too: 30 a minute with `POST /attachments`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chatId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[GC]?\d{8}$` | A chat the bot is in: `G…` a group, `C…` a channel, a person's id for the private chat with them. Any other id answers `chat_not_found`. |

Request body (multipart/form-data, required):

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | yes | format `binary` |  |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Changed. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `forbidden` or `bot_paused`. |
| `404` | `chat_not_found`: no such chat, or the bot is not in it. |
| `413` | `too_large`: a picture over 5 MiB or a clip over 12 MiB. |
| `415` | `bad_media`: not a picture or a clip. |
| `429` | `flood_wait` (too many of these in their window), `slow_mode` (a send into a group in slow mode) or `rate_limited` (too many calls). Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |
| `503` | `try_again`: the server is short of disk right now. |

## `GET /resolve/{username}`

**A public handle, turned into an id**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `resolve` |
| Tag | Names |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.resolve` |

For the handle a person types at your bot - "paga @anna", "segui @notizie" - when no message has handed you that id. People, groups and channels share one pool of names, so a handle is held by exactly one of the three and `kind` says which.

The answer carries `id` at the top, and the same thing again under `user` or `chat` with what little goes with it. `username` is the name that account or chat actually goes by, which is not always the one you asked with: a person can answer to several handles.

It finds anybody with a public handle, which is no more than the short link already tells a stranger with a browser (`hidesay.me/anna`). The id on its own grants nothing: sending still needs the bot to be in the chat, and a key still needs somebody the bot may look up. Out of reach: a chat with no public name (a private group is not in the pool at all), an account that has been closed, and the server's own service account.

Harder limit than the rest of the API: 60 a minute, and a handle nobody holds counts as five, so about a dozen blind guesses spend the minute. Over it you get `429 flood_wait` with `retryAfter`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | path | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,32}$` | A public handle, without the `@`. 3-32 characters: letters, digits and underscore. Case does not matter. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | What the handle turned out to be. |
| `400` | `bad_request`: the body or the query is wrong; `message` says which field. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `404` | `username_not_found`: nobody and no chat answers to that name. |
| `429` | `flood_wait`: too many lookups, wait `retryAfter` seconds. `rate_limited`. |

## `GET /users/{userId}/key`

**One person's public key**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getUserKey` |
| Tag | Chats |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_user_key` |

Only for somebody the bot may look up, by the same rule as `GET /users/{userId}`; anybody else is `user_not_found`, whether or not they exist.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Rules | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `userId` | path | string | yes | pattern `^B?\d{8}$` | A person's or a bot's id. A person's also works as the bare digits. |

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The key. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `403` | `bot_paused`: the owner paused the bot. Only `GET /me`, `GET /webhook`, `DELETE /webhook` and `POST /token/revoke` work meanwhile. |
| `404` | `user_not_found` or `no_user_key`. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `POST /token/revoke`

**Burn this token**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `revokeToken` |
| Tag | Token |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.revoke_token` |

For a programme that notices its token leaked. Nothing works again, this call included, until the owner issues a new token in the console; the owner is told at once. Works while paused.

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Revoked. |
| `401` | `unauthorized`: missing, revoked or invalid token. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## `GET /webbot/key`

**The key initData is signed with**

| | |
|---|---|
| operationId | `getWebBotKey` |
| Tag | Web-Bots |
| SDK | {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.AsyncClient.get_web_bot_key` |

The public half of the key the server signs every Web-Bot's `initData` with: 32 raw bytes, base64url without padding. It is the same for every bot and needs no token, so fetch it once and keep it in your configuration. Cached for an hour; 120 calls a minute per address.

How to check `initData` with it is under *Who opened it: initData* above, with a Node example; the Python library does it in `validate_web_bot_data`.

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The public key. |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: too many calls. Wait `retryAfter` seconds. |

## Webhook: `update`

**An update, delivered to your webhook**

One update per request, in order. Answer any 2xx within 10 seconds. The header `X-Hidesay-Bot-Api-Secret-Token` carries the secret you set, if any; `User-Agent` is `Hidesay-Bot-Api/1`. Deliveries are at least once: a slow 2xx can be retried, so treat `updateId` as the thing that makes a delivery new. They come from addresses that change over time: trust the secret token, not the IP.

The body is one `Update`. In the SDK: {py:meth}`~hidesay_bot.Bot.create_webhook_app`.

| Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Any 2xx: delivered. Anything else, a timeout or a redirect: retried later. |
